name: VRE
description:
VRE (Virtual Reality Economics) is the native token of the VRE 
  platform — a regulated social launchpad on Solana that combines a creator-owned 
  social network, an accountable token launchpad, on-chain vesting, US LLC formation 
  (in the future), and Liquid Democracy governance into a single product.

The social
   layer is a full creator network: videos with HLS streaming, image galleries, 
  long-form posts, an integrated marketplace for digital goods (PDFs, courses, NFTs, 
  services, bounties), and real-time chat with optional SOL escrow for paid messaging. 
  Profiles surface a user's complete portfolio across all four formats. Every 
  interaction — content, comments, follows, paid responses — builds the on-platform 
  reputation that determines who becomes an Expert in governance.

Unlike pure 
  speculation venues, every project launched on VRE comes with built-in accountability.
   VRE holds freeze authority over all tokenomics wallet allocations, releasing them 
  via proof of work — meaning tokens are released only to people doing real work for 
  the project (marketing via videos, development, etc.) or to people who buy through
  the ICO. Investors are protected: founders must build to receive their tokens. All
  holders — founders, Angel Round buyers, Round A buyers — unlock simultaneously on
  Liberation Day, creating a fair and unified market launch with no insider escape
  hatches.

Governance runs on a Liquid Democracy model. Any user can endorse one of
  up to 101 Experts to delegate their voting power, or vote independently. The top 101
  Experts by endorsement count form the Chairs council — a dynamic, real-time
  leaderboard with no election cycles — and 51% of voting power passes proposals on
  platform features, code commits, monetary policy, and token parameters. Experts are
  earned through platform contribution (knowledge, content, reputation), not only
  through token holdings.

The VRE token itself is the foundational currency of this
  ecosystem: used to participate in the different functions of the ecosystem, to vote
  in governance, and as the unit of value across the integrated marketplace (digital
  goods, services, bounties, paid chat). All VRE tokens — without exception — are
  locked from circulation until Liberation Day, when the entire supply unlocks for free
   trading on the open market.
